geometry_build.rebuild_limit: The Poly Haven and Khronos receipts pin the same mmgeo binary hash but record different main.cpp SHA-256 values. The archived patch reconstructs only the Khronos value, leaving source provenance unresolved. A retained build trace matches the recorded executable hash and preserves the MSBuild and main.cpp compiler invocations, but it does not establish which source hash produced the binary or verify a clean-source rebuild.

protocol_limitations: Coverage MAE was listed in the pre-score plan, but the pinned scorer emits silhouette XOR rather than coverage MAE; coverage MAE is unavailable and was not inferred.
The scorer did not measure GPU frame time, LPIPS, temporal stability, mobile hardware, or human preference.
The render comparison uses a fixed desktop image-quality protocol; it is not equal-frame-time evidence.
